A0.note: raw facts only; no engineered metrics, no deltas

A1.note: the metrics dict already includes a {key}_growth entry per metric, so year-over-year deltas are present

A2.note: A2 also carries the traditional-model outputs, but not any B0/B2/B6/Hybrid final score

A3.eligibility_blocker: requires a multi-period extraction extension from the same accession plus a temporal_evidence builder, implemented and frozen before the cohort is enumerated; E4's build_features extracts only two periods
A3.note: adds horizon (>= 3 fiscal years), not extra deltas: A2 already contains every delta B6 uses

confound_surface.statement: A1 and A2 packets contain every input that B0 and B6 use
evidence: ratio_risk_score consumes current_ratio, debt_to_assets, net_margin, cfo_to_net_income, fcf_margin (numeric_benchmark.py:10-27)
temporal_risk_score = 0.75 * ratio_risk_score + 0.25 * adverse/observed over revenue_growth, operating_cash_flow_growth, total_debt_growth, cash_growth (numeric_benchmark.py:30-46)
run_numeric passes metrics = row['metrics'] to both (e4_core.py:595, 603-604)
packet() exposes the same dict as engineered_features (e4_agent.py:78)
B6's own reason codes name those four growth keys (e4_core.py:611)
consequences: A2 vs B6 compares aggregation strategies over an identical feature set, not information access
the Agent can reproduce B6 exactly in principle, so a high H1 result may be imitation rather than reasoning
the Hybrid 0.5*B6 + 0.5*A2 fuses two aggregations of the same inputs
confound_surface.resolution: report the aggregation-equivalence diagnostic and phrase H1 as an aggregation question

aggregation_equivalence_diagnostic.interpretation_rule: if the Agent's advantage disappears once (B0, B6) are partialled out, report that the Agent re-weighted the baselines rather than adding information

temporal_evidence_schema.fiscal_years: ascending int list; A3 requires at least 3 years

<metric>.values: list aligned to fiscal_years; null means not reported

rules: every year must come from the same accession as the feature filing
no aggregate risk score and no monotone transform of B6
direction is defined on the raw series by a published rule with a dead band for stable
trajectory_class is defined on the raw series, not on any risk score
missingness is explicit: null plus years_missing, never a silently dropped year

forbidden_packet_values: any value equal to a baseline score for that observation, or any affine transform of one

monotone_rederivation_check.method: ordinary least squares fit of B6 from the packet's numeric fields, on the frozen packets
monotone_rederivation_check.rule: if fitted R^2 is at or above the prespecified ceiling, the representation is a re-encoding of the baseline and must be reported as such

guard_extension_required: extend the packet() forbidden-key guard to the list above and cover it with a test
